comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: This also works in the Labyrinth in Crete and the Poseidon temple in Atlantis as well. So if your after any of those rare recipes or items like the Mysterious Gold or Orichalcum, do consider having this on you. Another thing, if your a fleet, the player with Thief job and this skill doesn't need to be fleet admiral. As long as someone in the party has this it will work for everyone. :)
